newsitem.title: CAYMAN ISLANDS: Caymans monetary authority seeks director.
newsitem.headline: Caymans monetary authority seeks director.

text.p: The Cayman Islands government Friday said it was seeking a managing director for its new Monetary Authority, which will have control over the British territory's stock exchange.

The Monetary Authority is scheduled to be brought into the Caribbean islands' government in January 1997. It will incorporate the operations of the Caymans' current Financial Services Supervision Department and Currency Board.
The authority will have ultimate responsibility for the islands' 560 licensed banks and trust companies and 330 offshore and captive insurance firms.
John Fleming, acting inspector of financial services, said the recruitment process was well underway in Britain and said he hoped the post would be filled by January 1.
